job_hypothesis: Level the rig quickly at every stop, even alone
name: Gail Whitfield
location: Full-time RVer, winters in Quartzsite, Arizona
behaviors: Widowed and travels solo in a fifth-wheel
Levels the rig at every stop, often after dark
Walks back and forth between the jacks and a bubble level stuck on the hitch
values: A working fridge and a good night's sleep
current_alternatives: Bubble levels stuck on the hitch and the side of the rig
Leveling blocks and the jacks, adjusted by trial and error
A phone app set on the kitchen counter
Asking a neighbor at the campground to watch the bubble
objections: Bluetooth leveling sensors and automatic leveling systems for RVs already exist
She has bought gadgets before that died or needed fiddly pairing
A tone at the jacks doesn't tell her which side to raise or by how much
In daylight her bubble works fine; only night arrivals are a problem
